acceptance: Historical reconstruction with an explicit immutable prior authenticates that prior once per reconstruction edge while preserving the selected value, normalization audit and complete reconstructed context. Deterministic single-edge and controlled recursive cases retain unchanged assertion failures before the correction and pass afterward.

First-pass historical assembly establishes exact local prior-byte custody only. Historical materialization performs fresh full transitive native authentication and whole-context comparison before acceptance; producer capture and legacy prior discovery retain their existing authentication behavior.

Closed raw decisions, prior identities, source and origin bindings, retained criteria and mapping projections remain enforced. Invalid, missing, replayed or altered bindings and raw approval evidence fail closed without publishing a spec.

Prior archive movement between assembly and final authentication is refused. Archive authentication without ancestry remains distinct from ancestry admission, and an intact orphan archive remains refused when ancestry is required. Independent invocations preserve fresh verification.

The regression harness runs complete nonempty deterministic cases using consumer-owned fixtures under ignored repository scratch, launches no model or paid service, preserves historical artifacts and existing bounds, and grants no approval or client readiness through synthetic results.

Registration discovery accepts the complete previously supported fourteen-variant profile and complete current sixteen-variant profile without modifying descriptors. Incomplete, duplicate, unknown or mixed profiles and undeclared response fields or widened action contracts fail closed.
Optional related-contract metadata admits only bounded, unique, closed api.contract.get links. Malformed links, authority selectors and executable participation dispatch are rejected.

Consumer-owned synthetic HTTP discovery feeds the real registration validator and request builder. Requests preserve the exact discovered application, scoped API v1 route, context header and serialized document; foreign applications, partitions, routes and versions are rejected.

Parallel-wait consumption validates the closed parent envelope, parallel current node and at most 256 declared branch summaries. It preserves string statuses without inventing an enum or maximum, validates declared indices and optional instructions, errors, resolutions and actions, and returns verified summaries and original continuations without automatic effects or an invented polling schedule.

Parent and nested continuations retain existing safe URI, method, payload and approval validation through current action builders. Malformed and foreign actions fail before transport, original href bytes remain unchanged, and existing start, callback, standing-registration, recovery and terminal behavior remains supported.

Declared commercial admission failures preserve HTTP 403 nonretryable and HTTP 503 retryable semantics, exact public errors and existing recovery boundaries without automatic login, retry, route switching or mutation.

Registration discovery accepts the advertised optional error-branch usage metadata only with its exact closed sixteen-item callback quota schema and CALLBACK_LIMIT_REACHED conditional requirement. Current sixteen-variant profiles accept absent execution_ttl_hours or a positive safe-integer value; legacy fourteen-variant profiles require that positive value. Altered quota schemas or conditions, invalid TTL values and unknown limit keys reject without descriptor mutation.
